dataset.name: ogbn-papers100M

train.order: file order; training permutations specified below

valid.order: file order; training permutations specified below

test.order: file order; training permutations specified below

dataset.large_source_hashes: inherited from accepted reports; full execution binding must reverify, not rescanned in protocol freeze

model.activation_order: SAGEConv then dropout then ReLU except final layer
model.initialization: reset Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA/DGL immediately before model creation; paired initial-state hashes equal; reset training RNG after setup; freeze dropout and sampling RNG states separately from evaluation

training.sampler_graph_metadata_cache_lifetime: one graph/sampler/GIDS instance per 20-epoch run, including train/eval; rebuilding dataloader must retain sampler metadata and cache
training.epoch_rng: Immediately before training, reset Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA/DGL to the run seed, after model initialization and all setup; then persist training RNG across epochs. Epoch order uses a separate PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,epoch])); evaluation saves/restores all training RNG states. No requirement for group/raw trajectories to be equal.
training.paired_root_order: Identical complete random permutation for both arms for each seed/epoch; sampler trajectories may differ.

numerical_reproducibility.main_thread_rng: Before any parallel DGL seed, temporarily set DGL threads=1 and dgl.seed(0); restore16 threads; then initialize model and training RNG with the run seed.
numerical_reproducibility.scope: Same setting for both arms, all seeds/repeats, and source references.

gids.sampler: native DGL uniform NeighborSampler on normalized original graph, without replacement
gids.feature_layout: plain logical-ID order, 4 KiB storage/cache pages
gids.cpu_cache: RevPR page-adapted static cache; NOT original logical Top-K silently rounded

revpr.graph: reverse of normalized original graph, retain multiplicities
revpr.formula: p_next[v]=(1-d)/N+d*sum_(u->v in reversed graph)(p[u]/out_degree_reversed[u]); normalized self loops ensure no dangling nodes
revpr.reduction: deterministic streaming reference; parallel implementation must validate numerical/rank agreement
revpr.page_score: sum final scores of the 8 logical nodes in each complete page; tail-padded page excluded
revpr.ranking: descending page score, tie ascending page ID
revpr.selection: exactly cpu_cache_pages; expose all selected complete rows sorted by physical address

gids.train_order: PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,epoch])) permutation of official train IDs in original CSV order, epoch zero-based
gids.baseline_label: GIDS with explicit 4-KiB-page RevPR CPU-cache adaptation; same native extension and measurement path as Full

digit_full.replica_budget_rule: cap, not a forced minimum; record any unfillable budget, never add non-neighbors or hot members
digit_full.primary_policy: descending normalized owner degree then logical ID; exclude fixed hot logical nodes from group members; apply accepted primary unique-neighbor/covered-position rules
digit_full.grouping_rng: PCG64(0), deterministic owner/member ordering, resume exact post-primary state for replica stage

replica_priority.ranking: descending frozen visit count, descending normalized owner degree, ascending logical owner ID
replica_priority.allocation: each owner once, all eligible non-hot primary-owned uncovered unique neighbors grouped up to available cap, then degree/ID fallback; no refit from hot profiling or formal run

cpu_hot_selection.bootstrap: accepted forward g8 no-hot artifact (manifest audit snapshot bound); same fanouts16/5/5, CUDA group sampler required
cpu_hot_selection.train_order: PCG64(0) permutation of complete official train CSV order
cpu_hot_selection.count: int64 counter +1 per unique logical feature input per minibatch, after sampler dedup; no internal activation, label or eval frequency
cpu_hot_selection.ranking: descending logical count, tie ascending logical ID; choose exactly cpu_cache_rows; count and disclose zero-frequency selections if needed
cpu_hot_selection.packing: selected hot nodes sorted logical ID in a contiguous 4 KiB-aligned raw segment; no cold companions; no hot node in any primary/replica group
cpu_hot_selection.one_pass: bootstrap layout used for one dry-run, then hot set frozen and new Full layout rebuilt once; no circular hot/layout refit
cpu_hot_selection.reuse: single seed0 preprocessing artifact shared across all formal seeds; not per-seed optimized

bfs.graph: undirected training-induced normalized original graph, omit self edges; retain multiedge multiplicity for degree ordering as existing bfs_order.py
bfs.component_root: highest remaining degree, tie lowest logical ID; include isolated training nodes
bfs.epoch_order: shuffle complete 1024-node BFS blocks with PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,epoch])); retain within-block order and final 907-node tail
bfs.construction: stream original edges/CSC to training-induced representation; exact parity to reference required, no full E-length transient arrays assumed

digit_full.sampling_contract: unchanged inner raw sampler; existing outer weighted group units and logical dedup/explicit storage addressing; report target/actual fanout, underfilled owners, groups, inputs, EIDs; no padding or extra dummy edges
digit_full.train_order: PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,epoch])) permutation of official train IDs in original CSV order, epoch zero-based
digit_full.main_configuration_label: DiGiT (random batches; GR, NS, hot cache/packing, GPU FIFO, mixed I/O)

evaluation.trace_sampler: standard uniform logical sampling on original normalized graph
evaluation.validation: all 125265 official valid IDs in CSV order, 123 batches after each epoch
evaluation.test: all 214338 official test IDs in CSV order, 210 batches once after epoch20
evaluation.checkpoint: epoch20 model; no selection by validation/test
evaluation.train_rng: save/restore around trace construction/evaluation, or build trace in separate process
evaluation.cache: continues through validation; do not flush/recreate; shared logical evaluation trace maps to each arm physical primary rows with group flags false
evaluation.common_eval: same logical nodes, edges, features and labels across arms/seeds/repeats; no partial-eval headline
evaluation.quality_gate: average repeat results per seed first; mean paired final-test accuracy(Full-GIDS) >= -0.005 (0.5 percentage points); report all seed differences and intervals; no claim of statistical equivalence or guaranteed convergence

measurement.profile: off; no host/CUDA sampling profiler or extra per-batch synchronizations
measurement.primary_online: monotonic fresh process start through final evaluation/report completion, including hash verification, graph load, CPU cache preload, metadata init, all20epochs and evaluations
measurement.paper_epoch: sum complete epoch train wall /20; include first-batch lazy init and epoch-order/loader work, no warmup deletion
additional: preprocess graph/group/layout/cache profile and baseline RevPR cost
payload write and full verification separately
GPU/CPU metadata init and cache preload
per-epoch train/validation time and cumulative totals
100-batch window aggregate sampling/feature/wall, primary+replay commands/bytes, cache counters, actual inputs/edges/fanout shortfall
process-tree host RSS, pinned host cache, GPU device and allocator peaks
one-task cold total and amortized reuse scenarios with stated number of jobs
measurement.offline_accounting: credit no missing historical work as zero: bootstrap no-hot layout and first20 statistics are preprocessing dependencies; inherited costs incomplete => cold-from-raw total unknown until measured
measurement.interruption: retain failed attempt; fresh-process rerun of same immutable arm with attempt increment; do not mix resumed warm timing with fresh runs; checkpoints may be diagnostic only

statistics.pairing: same seed and repeat, reversed order in second repeat; no outlier deletion
statistics.aggregation: compute paired fractional reduction per seed/repeat, average repeats within seed, then equal-weight3seeds; also report pooled totals separately
statistics.intervals: 95% t interval over3 independent seed means, df2 (timing repeats are not additional independent seeds)
statistics.performance_gate: mean paired online-time reduction >0 and all3 seed mean reductions >0; same signs for complete20epoch train time; report intervals, statistical significance only if interval excludes0
statistics.claim_gate: performance gate AND quality gate AND all correctness gates; component breakdown monotonicity not required
